name: 고다현

tips.동사·시제: I'm 뒤에는 -ing: I'm studying, I'm living (I'm study ❌). 과거 질문엔 과거로, -ed 발음 또렷하게.
tips.관사·전치사: listen to music. nearby는 뒤에 아무것도 안 붙고, near 뒤엔 명사. on the bus / in a car. during + 명사. 나라 앞엔 관사 없음(the US, the UK 예외).
tips.문장 구조: 동사는 주어가 못 돼요: Having a cellphone is good. 주어 먼저: My university has the longest history.
tips.주어-동사: several, one of 뒤에는 복수명사. The bus doesn't come often.
tips.단어 선택: easier(more easier ❌), the biggest difference. success·successful·succeed, famous·popular, late·lately, indoor·indoors 구분.
tips.발음·철자: about, like 습관 줄이기! -ed 끝소리 또렷하게.

focus.1: Home·Study·Work 답변은 3문장으로 compact하게! about, like 습관 줄이기.
focus.2: Part 2 내용을 더 알차게, several 뒤엔 복수명사.
focus.4: always, sometimes 대신 쓸 빈도 표현 익히기.
focus.6: Part 2 서론 정확히 외우기, Part 3는 off-topic 금지!

compare: near + 명사: near my house · nearby 단독: a playground nearby
indoor 형용사: indoor sports · indoors 부사: stay indoors

cards.en: When I listen to music, I feel better.
cards.gram: listen to + 대상. to를 빼먹지 않기!

cards.en: There is a playground nearby.
cards.gram: nearby는 전치사가 아니라 뒤에 아무것도 안 붙어요. nearby my house ❌
cards.mine: There is a playground nearby my house.

cards.en: There is a playground near my house.
cards.gram: near 뒤에는 꼭 명사: near my house. near로 끝내기 ❌

cards.ko: 질문을 다르게 말씀해 주실 수 있나요?
cards.en: Can you rephrase the question?
cards.gram: Can you rephrase the question? = 질문을 조금 바꿔 말해 주시겠어요? 통째로 암기!

cards.ko: 잘 모르겠어요. 별로 관심이 없어서요. 하지만 배울 기회가 있으면 배우고 싶어요.
cards.en: I don't really know. I'm not very interested, but I'd like to learn if I have the chance.
cards.gram: 아이엘츠는 가장 쉬운 방법으로! 모르면 솔직하고 짧게 + 한 문장 덧붙이기.

cards.en: He is very punctual.
cards.gram: punctual = 시간을 잘 지키는.

cards.en: We were in the same batch.
cards.gram: batch = 동기, 기수. She is my batchmate.

cards.en: I get on well with my colleagues.
cards.gram: colleague = 직장 동료. get on well with = ~와 잘 지내다.

cards.en: I'm studying business.
cards.gram: I'm 뒤에는 -ing: I'm studying. 또는 I study / I'm majoring in ~.

cards.en: I'm crazy about movies.
cards.gram: 좋아한다는 표현 바꿔 쓰기: I'm interested in / I'm fond of / I'm a big fan of / I'm crazy about / I'm keen on.

cards.en: The bus doesn't come often.
cards.gram: 주어 the bus(하나)라 doesn't. 철자 doesn't!

cards.en: I was blown away by the view.
cards.gram: be blown away = 깜짝 놀라다, 감탄하다.

cards.en: I spend quality time with my family at the weekend.
cards.gram: quality time = (가족·친구와) 의미 있게 보내는 시간.

cards.en: On special days, we eat out at a fancy restaurant.
cards.gram: eat out = 외식하다. fancy restaurant = 근사한 식당.

cards.en: I've been to several countries.
cards.gram: several 뒤에는 복수명사! Part 2 서론에서 특히 조심.

cards.ko: 그는 성공한 사업가예요. 성공하려고 정말 열심히 일했어요.
cards.en: He is a successful businessman. He worked really hard to succeed.
cards.gram: success 명사(성공) · successful 형용사(성공한) · succeed 동사(성공하다).

cards.en: They should borrow money from banks.
cards.gram: borrow A from B = B에게서 A를 빌리다.

cards.en: More often than not, I eat at home.
cards.gram: 빈도 표현: more often than not 자주 · from time to time 가끔 · once in a blue moon 아주 가끔.

cards.en: I'm living in Seoul.
cards.gram: I'm 뒤에는 -ing: I'm living in. 또는 I live in. I'm live ❌

cards.en: It takes 10 minutes on foot.
cards.gram: It takes + 시간 + on foot = 걸어서 ~ 걸려요.

cards.en: It's a 10-minute bus ride.
cards.gram: It's a 10-minute walk / bus ride / drive / subway ride. minute은 단수!

cards.ko: 차 막히는 걸 피하려고 일찍 나왔어요.
cards.en: I left early to beat the traffic.
cards.gram: beat the traffic = 차 막히기 전에 움직이다. 막혔을 땐 I was stuck in traffic.

cards.en: It should be taken with a pinch of salt.
cards.gram: take something with a pinch of salt = 곧이곧대로 믿지 않고 걸러 듣다.

cards.en: These days, all the information is at our fingertips.
cards.gram: at one's fingertips = 바로 손닿는 곳에, 쉽게 얻을 수 있는.

cards.en: I always root for my team.
cards.gram: root for / cheer for = ~를 응원하다.

cards.en: As I grew up, I got interested in cooking.
cards.gram: As I grow up = 내가 커가면서. 과거 이야기면 grew.

cards.en: I sleep in at the weekend.
cards.gram: sleep in = 늦잠 자다.

cards.en: I've started working out lately.
cards.gram: late = 늦은, 늦게 · lately = 최근에.

cards.ko: 제가 가장 좋아하는 책 중 하나는 해리 포터예요.
cards.en: One of my favourite books is Harry Potter.
cards.gram: one of + 복수명사(books), 동사는 is(하나니까).
cards.mine: One of my favourite book is …

cards.en: My university has the longest history.
cards.gram: 주어(My university) 먼저, 그다음 동사: has the longest history.

cards.en: This is easier.
cards.gram: 짧은 형용사는 -er: easy → easier. more easier ❌

cards.en: Compared to other cities, Seoul is expensive.
cards.gram: compared to ~ / in comparison with ~ = ~와 비교하면.

cards.en: It depends on the situation.
cards.gram: It depends on ~ = ~에 따라 달라요.

cards.en: I listen to music on the bus.
cards.gram: 큰 교통수단은 on a plane / bus / train, 승용차는 in a car.

cards.ko: 아침에 잠을 깨려고 커피 한잔 해요.
cards.en: I grab a coffee to wake myself up.
cards.gram: grab a coffee = 커피 한잔 하다. wake myself up = 잠을 깨우다.

cards.en: This drink has a high amount of caffeine.
cards.gram: high caffeine ❌ → a high amount of caffeine.

cards.ko: 그는 유명하고, 그 노래는 인기가 많아요.
cards.en: He is famous, and the song is really popular.
cards.gram: famous = 유명한(많이 알려진), popular = 인기 많은(많이 좋아하는).

cards.ko: 야구 시즌 동안 경기를 자주 봐요.
cards.en: During baseball season, I often watch games.
cards.gram: during + 명사 = ~ 동안. when + 명사 ❌

cards.en: I do indoor exercise indoors.
cards.gram: indoor 형용사(실내의) + 명사 · indoors 부사(실내에서).

cards.en: I pigged out at the weekend.
cards.gram: pig out = 엄청 많이 먹다.

cards.en: I have a sweet tooth.
cards.gram: have a sweet tooth = 단 걸 좋아하다.

cards.en: Horror films are not my cup of tea.
cards.gram: not my cup of tea = 내 취향이 아닌.

cards.en: I eat snacks when I feel peckish.
cards.gram: feel peckish = 출출하다. mouth-watering = 군침 도는.

cards.en: Technology affects people a lot.
cards.gram: affect + 대상(to 없이). affect to ❌

cards.ko: 대부분의 기술은 삶을 더 편하게 해 줘요.
cards.en: Most technology makes life easier.
cards.gram: most + 명사. most of 뒤에는 the/my가 필요해요. technology는 셀 수 없는 명사.

cards.en: Technology improves the quality of life.
cards.gram: improve the quality of life = 삶의 질을 높이다.

cards.en: I try to keep up with the trends.
cards.gram: keep up with ~ = ~에 뒤처지지 않다.

cards.en: I tried to hold back my tears.
cards.gram: hold back = (감정 등을) 참다.

cards.en: Having said that, it's expensive.
cards.gram: Having said that, = 그렇긴 하지만. Come to think of it, = 생각해 보니.

cards.en: Let's take a breather.
cards.gram: take a breather = 잠깐 쉬다, 숨 돌리다.

cards.en: Everyone has to pull their weight.
cards.gram: pull one's weight = 자기 몫을 다하다.

cards.en: The biggest difference is the price.
cards.gram: 차이가 크다는 big: the biggest difference. the most difference ❌

cards.en: Having a cellphone is good.
cards.gram: 동사는 그대로 주어가 못 돼요. -ing로: Having a cellphone is good.

cards.en: I've been to Japan and the US.
cards.gram: 나라 이름 앞에는 관사 없음! 예외: the US, the UK.

cards.en: I feel depressed on rainy days.
cards.gram: feel depressed = 우울하다(사람). 날씨가 우울하면 depressing.

cards.en: The island is a wildlife sanctuary.
cards.gram: sanctuary = (야생동물) 보호구역.

qs: Do you think small businesses are important for the economy?

part3.topic: Describe a piece of technology that you would like to own
qs: How has technology changed people's daily lives?

Why do some people always want to buy the latest technology?

part3.topic: Describe an environmental law you would like your country to introduce

What should individuals be doing to protect the natural environment?
How could the government help prevent pollution?
Do you think young people today are more aware of environmental problems?
Do you think it's important to protect trees?
Do you think more money should be spent on protecting wild animals?
